try: Open a new lead form with one key
how:
1. Click "Leads" in the side navigation
2. Click an empty part of the page (not a search box)
3. Press the C key
expect: The "Create New Lead" form opens with the cursor already in "Lead name".
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Let the document reader fill a lead for you
how:
1. In the open form, click "Fill from a document"
2. Press "Upload" (no file needed — this is a demo)
3. Look at the fields, then press "Cancel" at the bottom
expect: Empty fields fill with a sample enquiry (Nurul Hassan, Condo 3-bedder, East) and a PDF is attached; Cancel closes without saving anything.
in10: Different from 1.0: fixed sample values stand in for AI reading

try: Get warned about a lead you already have
how:
1. Click "Add Lead", then "Create New Lead"
2. "Lead name": Test Duplicate · "Lead phone number": 9123 8803
3. Press "Create"
4. In the warning, press "Open existing lead"
5. Look at his lead in the new browser tab, close that tab, then press "Cancel" on your form
expect: "A lead with this phone already exists" names Kenji Sato · 9123 8803 · Lost; the button opens his lead in a new browser tab while your form stays as you left it; nothing new is created.
in10: Different from 1.0: "Create anyway" creates it, not held for review

try: Start Sophia's lead and test the budget limit
how:
1. Back on "Leads", click "Add Lead", then "Create New Lead"
2. "Lead name" Sophia Wong · "Lead phone number" 9765 4321 · "Lead source" Referral · "Property type" HDB 4-Room · "Property address" Blk 201 Tampines Street 21 · "District" East — leave "Assign member" empty
3. Open "Additional info": "Lead email" sophia.wong@example.com · "Estimated budget (S$)" 500
4. Press "Create"
expect: The form stays open and the budget box says "Enter a budget between S$1,000 and S$5,000,000".
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Save Sophia's lead with her floor plan attached
how:
1. Change "Estimated budget (S$)" to 60,000
2. "Condition" Resale · "Key collection" in 3 months (fill any custom field your studio still has)
3. Open "Additional info" and scroll to its end; under "Attach files (optional)" press "Attach" and pick sophia-floor-plan.pdf
4. Press "Create"
expect: "Successfully Created"; Sophia Wong tops the list in New, with a coloured band on the left and "Assign" under Members.
in10: Different from 1.0: one name field; only name and phone required

try: Upload a spreadsheet of new leads
how:
1. Click "Add Lead", then "Import from File"
2. Drop new-leads.xlsx on "Drop your file or browse"
3. Press "Next"
4. Read the column list, then press "Next" again
expect: "Success!" says "Detected 5 line(s)"; all 11 columns are tagged "Auto-matched"; the preview table lists the five rows.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Send the clean leads straight to your list
how:
1. Press "Import"
2. In "Lead routing" choose "Add to my lead listing", press "Import"
3. Read the result, press "Done"
expect: "4 of 5 records imported successfully" · "3 leads added to your listing · 1 possible duplicate sent to review"; three new leads appear.
in10: New in 2.0

try: See the import on record, with the row it skipped
how:
1. On Leads, click ⋮ ("More options"), then "Lead Import History"
2. Find new-leads.xlsx
3. Click "Download Skipped Records"
expect: The row reads 5 total, 4 imported and "1 error detected across 1 skipped lead"; the download lists the nameless row with "Missing Lead Name".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Import a PDF lead sheet to check first
how:
1. Back on Leads, click "Add Lead", then "Import from File"
2. Drop homematch-lead-sheet.pdf, press "Next" twice
3. Press "Import", choose "Review and approve manually", press "Import"
4. Press "Done"
expect: "Detected 2 line(s)"; the result reads "2 of 2 records imported successfully" and "2 leads waiting in Review imported leads"; the list itself is unchanged.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Open the review queue
how:
1. On Leads, click the "Review imported leads" bar at the bottom
2. Find Gerald Tan and your two PDF leads
3. Switch on "Show only duplicates", then off again
expect: Gerald Tan is tagged DUPLICATE with "Matches: Gerald Tan"; Vanessa Ho and Samuel Yeo are PENDING; the switch narrows the queue to duplicates.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Merge the repeat enquiry into Gerald's lead
how:
1. On Gerald Tan's card press "View & Merge"
2. In the "Budget (S$)" row, click the round button beside 120,000 (the "New" column)
3. Read the "Merged result" column
4. Press "Merge into Existing"
expect: Phone says "identical - matched on this"; Email and District fill in by themselves; "Merged into the existing lead"; Gerald's budget becomes 120,000.
in10: Different from 1.0: side by side; you pick each clashing value

try: Approve the two PDF leads
how:
1. In the queue, click the "Others (2)" chip
2. On Vanessa Ho's card press "Approve"
3. On Samuel Yeo's card press "Approve"
4. Close the queue
expect: Each press says "Lead approved and added to your leads"; both leads now show in the list in New.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Receive a lead from an ad form (Webhooks)
how:
1. On Leads, click "Add Lead", then "Link to Zapier"
2. In the "Webhooks" card, find the "Google Ads" row
3. Press "Simulate a POST (demo)"
expect: A message says someone "arrived via Google Ads" (new, or a known number sent to review); the counters rise and "Recent activity" gains a row.
in10: Different from 1.0: a demo POST stands in for real traffic

try: Pick up leads from portal emails
how:
1. Scroll to the "Email lead sources" card
2. Press "Connect Gmail"
3. Press "Sync now"
expect: "Gmail connected — the platforms below are monitored"; the card turns ACTIVE; Sync now names who "enquired via @…" and EMAILS FOUND reads 1.
in10: Different from 1.0: a stand-in inbox; each sync plays one enquiry

try: Check the lead that came from Qanvast
how:
1. On Leads, open Hakim Salleh
2. Look at the source chip, then open ⋮ ("More options")
3. Click "Qanvast Ops" in the side navigation and find Hakim Salleh
expect: His QANVAST chip is green and the menu offers "Return Lead"; Qanvast Ops lists him with Return window "Opens in 7 days".
in10: New in 2.0

scene: Find your way around the list
try: Find Sophia by part of her phone number
how:
1. On Leads, click the search box ("Search name, phone, email…")
2. Type 9765
3. Replace it with zzzz
4. Press "Clear All"
expect: 9765 leaves only Sophia Wong, digits highlighted; zzzz shows "No results found"; "Clear All" brings every lead back.
in10: Different from 1.0: matches anything shown; phone at any length

scene: Find your way around the list
try: Show only leads nobody owns yet
how:
1. Click the Filters icon ("Filters")
2. Open "Quick filters" and tick "Unassigned"
3. Press "Done"
expect: Only leads with "Assign" under Members remain — Sophia Wong and the new imports among them; the Filters icon shows 1.
in10: Different from 1.0: no Hot filter; Unseen added

scene: Find your way around the list
try: Give two new leads to Alex in one go
how:
1. With the filter still on, tick Aaron Goh and Priscilla Low (not Sophia)
2. In the bar at the bottom press "Assign"
3. Tick "Alex", then press "Assign"
expect: The bar counts 2; "2 leads assigned to Alex" appears and both leave the Unassigned list; Sophia stays unassigned.
in10: Different from 1.0: adds members; never replaces or unassigns

scene: Find your way around the list
try: Narrow the list to leads created this month
how:
1. Click "Filters", then "Date"
2. Choose "This month"
3. Press "Done"
expect: Only unassigned leads created since the 1st of this month remain, today's included; the Filters icon shows 2.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Export exactly what the list shows
how:
1. Click ⋮ ("More options"), then "Export all as…"
2. Choose "What the list shows"; "Columns": As the list shows; "Choose file format": XLSX
3. Press "Export"
4. Then "Filters" › "Clear All" › "Done"
expect: The summary line counts those leads and columns; an XLSX downloads with "Exported … as XLSX"; Clear All brings every lead back.
in10: Different from 1.0: all or shown leads; four formats

try: Look at one stage, one source and one member
how:
1. Click "All Leads (…)" and pick "Contacted"
2. "Filters": in "Source" tick Qanvast, in "Members" tick Dane, in "Sort" pick "Oldest at the top"; "Done"
3. Read the list
4. "Filters" › "Clear All" › "Done"; then the pill › "All Leads"
expect: The pill reads "Contacted (2)" with a dot: Jasmine Lee above Gavin See; clearing both brings every lead back.
in10: Different from 1.0: stages on the pill; filters combine freely

try: Add the District and follow-up columns
how:
1. Click the "Column settings" icon (right of Filters)
2. Switch on "District", "Next follow-up" and "Last contact"
3. Press "Done"
expect: Three columns appear; on Sophia's row DISTRICT reads East and LAST CONTACT reads "No contact yet"; NEXT FOLLOW-UP shows when (day, date and time over "in n days"), while TASKS names the task.
in10: New in 2.0

try: See the board and the owner-first rule
how:
1. Switch to the board ("Kanban view", top right of the list)
2. Drag Sophia Wong's card from New to Contacted
3. Switch back to "Table view"
expect: Seven stage columns sit under ACTIVE and INACTIVE; Sophia's card springs back with "Assign a member first".
in10: Different from 1.0: seven stage columns, not four buckets
